description: This file 'cli.py' is a CLI entry point for a project initialization tool. It processes command-line arguments to create and initialize various project types, handles special commands like retrieving run commands, and outputs configuration details in JSON format. It imports standard libraries (`argparse`, `json`, `os`, `pathlib`, `typing`) and internal modules related to template configuration and project initialization.

classes.name: ProjectConfig
classes.description: Configuration object holding project parameters such as name, version, description, author, type, output path, and custom parameters.

classes.name: ProjectType
classes.description: Enumeration or class representing different supported project types, with a method to parse from string.

classes.name: TemplateInitInfo
classes.description: Data structure encapsulating initial template configuration details, including commands and environment info.

classes.name: ProjectInitializer
classes.description: Main class responsible for creating project templates and executing initialization routines.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] parse_parameters(params_str: str)
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated key=value string into a dictionary with suitably typed values.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_project_config(args)
methods.description: Creates a ProjectConfig instance from CLI arguments.

methods.name: ProjectConfig create_minimal_project_config(project_type: str, parameters: str = None)
methods.description: Creates a minimal ProjectConfig instance to retrieve template info without full user input.

methods.name: str make_path_absolute(path: str, base_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a relative path to an absolute path based on a given base directory.

methods.name: dict template_init_info_to_dict(init_info: TemplateInitInfo, project_path: Path)
methods.description: Converts a TemplateInitInfo object into a dictionary suitable for JSON serialization, with absolute paths for files.

methods.name: output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
methods.description: Formats and prints a JSON object indicating success or failure, including message and optional template info.

methods.name: output_get_run_command(project_type: str, run_command: str)
methods.description: Outputs JSON with the project type and its associated run command.

methods.name: handle_get_run_command(args)
methods.description: Handles the --get-run-command argument; creates a minimal project config, retrieves the template's init info, and outputs the run command.

methods.name: main()
methods.description: The main CLI entry point handling argument parsing, project creation, and command dispatching.

ctags.name: output_json
ctags.pattern: /^def output_json(success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_pat/
ctags.signature: (success: bool, message: str, template_info: TemplateInitInfo = None, project_path: Path = None)
